_note: STARTING POINT — curated by ClauseWise maintainers. Review and extend before each release. Not legal advice; used only for severity comparison within the tool.

typical_patterns.typical: Fixed rate stated as an annual percentage rate (APR). Variable rate tied to a named benchmark with a cap. Rate disclosed before contract signed.
red_flags: variable rate with no cap
compound interest applied more frequently than monthly without clear disclosure
APR not stated; only monthly rate shown
rate can be changed unilaterally by lender

typical_patterns.typical: No prepayment penalty, or a modest fee (e.g., 1–2% of outstanding balance) limited to the first 1–3 years.
red_flags: penalty for early repayment exceeds 3% of outstanding balance
penalty applies for the full loan term
penalty calculated on original principal rather than outstanding balance

typical_patterns.typical: Default clearly defined (e.g., payment missed by 30+ days). Cure period (e.g., 10–15 days notice) before acceleration. Remedies proportionate to breach.
red_flags: single missed payment triggers immediate acceleration of entire balance
cross-default provision with other unrelated obligations
lender can declare default for any business reason
no cure period

typical_patterns.typical: All fees itemised upfront: origination fee, late payment fee (flat or small percentage), returned payment fee. No fees added post-signing without consent.
red_flags: catch-all 'administrative fees' with no cap
fees can be added at lender/vendor discretion
penalty interest rate far above contract rate on default
undisclosed fees revealed at closing

typical_patterns.typical: Collateral clearly described. Conditions for enforcement of security interest defined. Over-collateralisation disclosed.
red_flags: blanket lien on all assets including future assets
lender may seize collateral without court process
cross-collateralisation with other unrelated loans
collateral value grossly disproportionate to loan amount

typical_patterns.typical: Vendor warrants services/goods meet agreed specification. Liability capped at amounts paid in last 12 months. Consequential loss excluded.
red_flags: vendor disclaims all warranties including fitness for purpose
liability cap is zero or nominal
vendor can substitute goods/services unilaterally
client bears all risk of vendor's failure to deliver

typical_patterns.typical: Net 30 payment terms. Late payment interest at statutory rate or disclosed rate. Invoice disputes resolved before payment withheld.
red_flags: payment due immediately on invoice with no grace period
late fees compound monthly at a high rate
vendor can suspend service immediately on non-payment without notice
set-off rights excluded entirely

typical_patterns.typical: Either party may terminate on 30–60 days notice. On termination: work completed to date paid for, outstanding obligations settled.
red_flags: no termination right for client
termination by client triggers large penalty
vendor retains all work product on early termination
termination payment exceeds remaining contract value
